data.gender_notes: Akaayla is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Akaayla is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Akas' meaning sky and 'Kal' meaning night or time. Akaayla represents the radiance of the moon in the sky at night, reflecting the light of the heavens and inspiring awe and wonder. The name Akaayla carries the meaning “Moonlight, radiant one” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Akaayla usually hope their child will grow to embody moonlight, radiant one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
